set.body:
Faceting multiplies the pipeline cost in three separable ways. Depends on the
data/device split landing first, since that changes what "a pass" costs.

1. **(panels + 1) passes.** `FacetCompiler.scala:114-121` runs
   `MappingPhase.planPanels`, then `StatPhase.transform` per panel, then
   `resolveLayers` per panel, on top of one global pass for shared scale
   training (`:39-52`). Under `FacetScales.Shared` -- the default -- the
   per-panel scale work is largely redundant with the global pass. Establish
   what can be computed once and read per panel.

2. **Empty cells cost a full pass.** `facetGrid` materializes the full row x
   column cross product (`Facet.scala:188-194`), unlike `facetWrap` which
   allocates only observed or declared levels (`:139-148`). A sparse design --
   the normal case for an unbalanced study -- pays for every absent
   combination. An empty cell should short-circuit to an empty panel with the
   shared scales and a strip, at near-zero cost, while still *rendering* (an
   empty panel is scientifically meaningful and must not silently vanish).

3. **Provenance default.** `PlotBuilder.resolve` defaults to `rich` (Full
   provenance) while `PlotCompiler.compile` defaults to `lean`
   (`docs/limits.md:133-134`, `PlotCompiler.scala:80-90`). A faceted plot
   built through the DSL therefore retains one `ResolvedRow` per datum per
   panel and forfeits the point-batch IR, which only engages when
   `provenance != Full` for `Geom.Point` with `StatLowering.Geom`
   (`docs/limits.md:91-94`). Either reconsider the DSL default, or make the
   cost discoverable -- right now a consumer gets the expensive path without
   asking for it and with no diagnostic.

Row partitioning itself is already O(rows) with a hash lookup
(`Facet.scala:255-275`) and is not the problem.

Acceptance: `facet-grid-30`, `facet-grid-sparse` and `rich-vs-lean` improve
against their recorded baselines; sparse grids approach the cost of their
occupied-cell count; and rendered output is unchanged, verified panel by
panel rather than in aggregate.
set.title: Facet compile cost: share work across panels and stop paying for empty grid cells
